title: Rain Lessons
summary: Hisame teaches you to break a weave. A hunter arrives.

lines: Three days of rain, and you're still out here. Good.
Which is why today's lesson matters. Last time you won by hitting harder. Next time he'll weave faster.
So you'll learn to break a weave. Watch the seals over a clone's head. Before the last one lands, hit it. A kunai is enough for these.

beats.text: Break a clone's weave: hit it before its last seal ({throw_tool} throws a kunai)

lines: Better. You stopped watching their hands and started watching their seals.
Hisame of Emberwood. Your yard is loud.
Tsumugi. The Windward Watch doesn't visit without a reason.
I've tracked a man with a stolen seal across three valleys. He came from here.
So the academy knows his name. Does it know what the last seal holds?
...A binding. The scroll's makers put something inside it.
Something with a name. Nue. A spirit stitched together from five beasts, one for each nature. Break the seal and it wakes.
I don't work with academies. But I'll work with anyone who can keep up. Show me, {name}.

phases.say: Wind clone! Let's see you handle two of me.

lines: ...You fight like someone who reads the seals. Fine. You'll do.
Kagerou's people were seen in the Autumn Wood, gathering clones. Tomorrow we go through them.
Take Asahi. He'll never forgive either of us otherwise.
